heading: INT. CANNERY WORKERS' HALL - DINING ROOM - NIGHT

units.text: INT. CANNERY WORKERS' HALL - DINING ROOM - NIGHT
A long plank table under a flickering chandelier made of fishing floats.
Salted air.
Six places set, five plates filled, one empty.
Rain batters the windows.
ELSPETH MARROW, 60s, presides at the head.
THADDEUS, 50s, her brother, sits at her right, carving a roast with no appetite.
YUKI, 30s, a guest in a sharp navy suit, sits across with her hands in her lap.
RODERICK, 40s, the cannery manager, loosens his collar.
MIRABEL, 20s, the cook's niece, pours wine with a trembling hand.
PERCIVAL, 70, deaf, bearded, nods off in his chair.
We were seven when the whistle blew in 'sixty-three.
units.name: ELSPETH

units.text: Eight.
units.name: THADDEUS

units.text: Seven. One of us never came to dinner.
units.name: ELSPETH

units.text: I don't recall.
units.name: RODERICK

units.text: No. You wouldn't.
units.name: ELSPETH

units.text: Mrs. Marrow, I came to discuss the sale of the cannery.
units.name: YUKI

units.text: You came to eat, dear. The sale is dessert.
units.name: ELSPETH

units.text: Wine, ma'am?
units.name: MIRABEL

units.text: Pour, child. Pour as if the glasses were hungry.
units.name: ELSPETH

units.text: Mirabel pours.
The wine sloshes.
She does not look at the empty place.
It was a good harvest that year. The fish were thick. We worked three shifts for three weeks, and the sea took only what it was owed.
units.name: THADDEUS

units.text: That's not how I remember it.
units.name: RODERICK

units.text: You remember it from the office.
units.name: THADDEUS

units.text: I remember the ledger.
units.name: RODERICK

units.text: The ledger is a liar. It says seven and it lies.
units.name: ELSPETH

units.text: Mrs. Marrow, whose place is empty?
units.name: YUKI

units.text: Percival stirs, mutters, falls asleep again.
The chandelier floats sway.
Elspeth sets down her fork.
She does it slowly, with great ceremony.
It is the place of the one who is coming.
units.name: ELSPETH

units.text: Nobody is coming.
units.name: RODERICK

units.text: The tide is.
units.name: ELSPETH

units.text: Thunder rattles the windows.
The lights gutter.
When they steady, the empty plate is no longer empty.
A single sardine, whole, wet, lies across it, its eye round and gold.
Nobody speaks.
Mirabel drops the bottle.
Yuki rises.
Thaddeus lays down his carving knife and, for the first time, looks at his sister with terror.
Elspeth. What have you done?
units.name: THADDEUS

units.text: I invited him.
units.name: ELSPETH

units.text: Out in the dark, beneath the floorboards, something heavy shifts.
